reviews.review_msg: Dr. Kenny taught us the history of Vancouver by taking us to historical sites in downtown. There are no quizzes on this "lecture" content, so you're really able to fully absorb and enjoy learning about the history around you. He is a tough marker, but you learn a lot from his feedback. I cannot recommend this class and Dr. Kenny enough, 10/10.

I took HIST435 in Fall 2024 and to this day its still my favourite class of all time. Lectures were kinda like walking tours around Vancouver. There were no quizzes or tests which meant you could really enjoy what Dr. Kenny teaches about Vancouver. He's a tougher marker, but not impossible. I cannot emphasize enough how much I recommend Dr. Kenny.
